name: Deno Deploy Free
free_limit: Free Deno Deploy: 1M inbound requests/month, 20 GiB egress/month, 5 custom domains, 10 active CPU hours and 150 GiB-hours of memory time
watch_out: Full published Free allowances require organization verification with a credit card; unverified organizations receive restricted Free limits. Apps are paused when request, egress, CPU or memory limits are exhausted until the billing cycle resets. Pro/Builder charge for overages; this is new Deno Deploy, not retired Deploy Classic (sunset July 20, 2026). Commercial eligibility should be verified with Deno.
